_about: Voiceover lines for marketing/*.mp4 (15 s each). Each line starts at `at` seconds and must end before `end` (the scene change). `style` is the acting direction. Brand names are spelled in Arabic so the voice says them naturally.
dialect: You are a native Lebanese Arabic speaker from Beirut. Speak natural, everyday Lebanese dialect (Levantine), never Egyptian and never Modern Standard Arabic; say ق as a glottal stop like Beirutis do. Sound like a real person recording a casual voice note to a friend: relaxed, warm, conversational rhythm, natural breaths and small pauses, slight smile in the voice. Never theatrical, never an announcer or a TV ad. English words (ProHost, meeting, studio, app) are said the way Lebanese people say them in English.

posts.persona: Confident, warm Lebanese businessman in his 40s talking to fellow property owners.

lines.style: Curious and slightly teasing, a knowing half-smile, rising question at the end.
lines.text: عِنْدَك مَكْتَب أَو عِيادِة… فاضْيِة؟

lines.style: Brisk, confident and upbeat ad read, quick rhythm through the list, no long pauses.
lines.text: مَع ProHost أَجِّرْها عَ ذَوْأَك: بِالسّاعَة، بِاليَوْم، بِالشَّهْر، أَو عَ الشَّخْص.

lines.style: Reassuring but brisk, a friend who has it all under control; keep it moving, no long pauses.
lines.text: كِلّ الطَّلَبات بْمَحَلّ واحَد، وبْتْغَيِّر سِعْرَك وَئِت ما بَدَّك.

lines.style: Excited, celebratory announcement with a big smile, punchy and quick, no long pauses.
lines.text: وْهَلَّأ، أَوَّل اشْتِراك بِـ ProHost Premium بْنُصّ السِّعْر!

posts.persona: Warm, modern Lebanese woman in her late 20s presenting an app she loves.

lines.style: Slow, confident, inviting, with a small pause between the two words.
lines.text: شِغْلَك… بْشُروطَك.

lines.style: Bright and enthusiastic, discovering the map.
lines.text: كِلّ المَكاتِب عَالخَريطَة، احْجُوز بِاليَوْم، أَو بِالسّاعَة.

lines.style: Easy, friendly, matter-of-fact.
lines.text: بْتِعْرِف شو فاضي هَلَّأ، وبْتِحْكي صاحِب المَحَلّ عَالْ WhatsApp.

lines.style: Professional and reassuring, speaking to space owners.
lines.text: وْلَأَصْحاب المَساحات، كِلّ شي قِدّامَك.

lines.style: Punchy and proud slogan, energy rising on the last phrase.
lines.text: ProHost: لاقيها، احْجِزْها، وِشْتِغِل.

posts.persona: Calm, gentle clinical psychologist in her 30s; soft and thoughtful, never salesy.

lines.style: Soft, warm introduction, a little tired of paying for a full-time clinic.
lines.text: أَنا psychologist بِالأَشْرَفِيِّة. بَدّي عِيادِة يَوْمَيْن بِالجِمْعَة بَسّ.

lines.style: Relaxed and pleased, explaining how simple it was, gentle pace.
lines.text: عَ ProHost بِخْتار الـ shift الصَّباحي، التَّلاتا والخَميس، لَأَرْبَع جِمَع… وبِبْعَت الطَّلَب.

lines.style: Quietly happy and fulfilled, a soft smile in the voice.
lines.text: صار عِنْدي عِيادْتي، يَوْمَيْن بِالجِمْعَة. ProHost.

posts.persona: Energetic corporate trainer in his 30s, dynamic and a little playful.

lines.style: Energetic, slightly exasperated about working from cafés, playful.
lines.text: مَرْحَبا، أَنا trainer. عِنْدي تَدْريب لَتْمَنْطَعْش شَخْص السَّبْت!

lines.style: Fast, efficient, satisfied, like ticking boxes.
lines.text: عَ ProHost القاعَة مْسَعَّرَة عَ الشَّخْص: بْحُطّ تْمَنْطَعْش، بْزيد كوفي بْريك، وبِبْعَت الطَّلَب.

lines.style: Triumphant and proud, a confident punchline.
lines.text: تْمَنْطَعْشَر كِرْسي… بْكَبْسِة وِحْدِة! ProHost.

posts.persona: Bright, upbeat life coach in her late 20s, positive and motivating.

lines.style: Cheerful and a bit cheeky, the question is rhetorical.
lines.text: أَنا life coach بِالحَمْرا. عِنْدي جَلْسْتَيْن بَسّ… لَيْش إِدْفَع شَهْر؟

lines.style: Light and quick, delighted at how easy it is, ending with a happy 'done'.
lines.text: بِفْتَح ProHost، بْشوف شو فاضي، بِخْتار ساعَة أَرْبْعَة وْساعَة خَمْسِة… وْخِلْصِت!

lines.style: Motivating and warm, speaking straight to the viewer.
lines.text: احْجُوز بِالسّاعَة، وِشْتِغِل مِن وَيْن ما بَدَّك. ProHost.

posts.persona: Composed, ambitious dietitian in her 30s; warm but determined.

lines.style: Determined and hopeful, with a firm 'but' about the long lease.
lines.text: مَرْحَبا، أَنا أَخِصّائِيِّة تَغْذِيِة بْجونْيِة. بَدّي عِيادْتي… بَلا عَقْد طَويل.

lines.style: Relieved and practical, it just worked.
lines.text: عَ ProHost لْقيت عِيادِة جاهْزِة، اخْتَرْت تْلات شْهور… وْبْبَلِّشْها الشَّهْر الجّايي.

lines.style: Warm, confident invitation to the viewer.
lines.text: عِيادْتَك الخاصّة، شَهْر بْشَهْر، بَلا عَقْد طَويل. ProHost.

posts.persona: Hotel general manager in Hamra in his 40s; calm, friendly, matter-of-fact, talking to other business owners.

lines.style: Easy-going, a little rueful about the empty rooms.
lines.text: نِحْنا أوتيل بِالحَمْرا، وقاعات الـ meeting عِنّا فاضْيِة أَغْلَب أَيّام الجِمْعَة.

lines.style: Pleased and relaxed, telling a small success story.
lines.text: حَطَّيْناها عَ ProHost بِالشَّخْص… إِجانا طَلَب لَخَمْسَة وعِشْرين شَخْص، وقِبِلْناه بِكَبْسِة.

lines.style: Friendly tip to a colleague, warm and direct.
lines.text: وهَلَّأ، أَوَّل اشْتِراك Premium بْنُصّ السِّعْر.

posts.persona: Administrator of a medical center in Sin el Fil in her 30s; composed, practical, kind.

lines.style: Calm and practical, stating a fact.
lines.text: نِحْنا مَرْكَز طِبّي بْسِنّ الفيل. عِنّا تْلات عِيادات فاضْيِين كِلّ بَعْد الضُّهْر.

lines.style: Satisfied, simple explanation, a soft smile.
lines.text: عَ ProHost أَجَّرْناهُن بِالشيفْت، ودَكْتورَة جِلْدِيِّة حَجَزِت التَّنين والأَرْبْعا.

lines.style: Warm, encouraging.
lines.text: الوَئِت الفاضي صار دَخِل. أَوَّل اشْتِراك بْنُصّ السِّعْر.

posts.persona: Director of a training institute in Kaslik in his 30s; upbeat, friendly, a bit enthusiastic.

lines.style: Friendly, slightly amused.
lines.text: نِحْنا مَعْهَد تَدْريب بِالكَسْليك. الصُّفوف فاضْيِة كِلّ مَسا وكِلّ weekend.

lines.style: Enthusiastic but natural, like sharing good news.
lines.text: صِرْنا نْأَجِّرْها عَ ProHost عَ عَدَد الأَشْخاص… وكِلّ طَلَب بيوْصَلْنا، مِنْقْبَل أَو مِنْرْفُض.

lines.style: Upbeat invitation.
lines.text: خَلّي صُفوفَك تِشْتِغِل. أَوَّل اشْتِراك بْنُصّ السِّعْر.

posts.persona: Owner of a small yoga studio in Mar Mikhael in her late 20s; bright, easy-going, genuine.

lines.style: Light, honest, a little laugh in the voice.
lines.text: عِنْدي studio يوغا بْمار مِخايِل، وما بْيِمْتِلي قَبِل السِّتّة المَسا.

lines.style: Happy and casual, telling a friend.
lines.text: حَطّيت السّاعات الفاضْيِة عَ ProHost، وأُسْتاذِة pilates حَجَزِت الصُّبْح كِلّ جِمْعَة.

lines.style: Warm, cheerful nudge.
lines.text: كِلّ ساعَة فاضْيِة فيها تْجيبْلَك مَصاري. وأَوَّل اشْتِراك بْنُصّ السِّعْر.
